name: IED spikes (hand-sorted)
note: Hand-sorted IEDs, imported from PTEN_M13_pten_m13s2aug1. 423 events from the detector; 111 were rendered and filed by hand and the rest were never looked at, so they are unspecified rather than rejected. Filed: 1 Flag, 81 Garbage, 11 Solid, 18 Sputter. Times are the MIDPOINT of the table's on/off pair at 30000 Hz, which is what the review images are aligned to; the onset is 2*start - end. `Evt###` is a 1-based row of that table. Both established by measurement -- see tools/import_ied.py. Evt035 (Sputter over Solid), Evt040 (Sputter over Solid) in two categories at once; the newer copy was taken, which is somebody changing their mind and leaving the old one. 9 pictures were withdrawn into a Hidden folder; a withdrawal is not a verdict, so those are unlabelled here. Below the categories there is a finer sort (Dentate Spike 28, Flag 20, Flag for Deep Review 8, Garbage 21) whose folders overlap rather than partition, so it was not read as verdicts; the folders remain the record. Version 2 keeps only the Solid events -- 11 of 423 -- so the set can be plotted without filtering. The fuller version is still v1; nothing was deleted.
units: seconds relative to the start of the recording
